title: Outside audit of the Marangoni rods, third version: M supported as a minority trait (about 5% of dividing rods, on fresh seeds 61-64), with S, I, B, W, D
summary: Under the ruling that a minority capability is acceptable when it replicates, this audit supports M: each of fresh seeds 61-64 has a rod that swims 3.2-4.7 of its own lengths and then divides into lasting daughters (5 of 61 dividing tracks). The minority is not inherited and appears on about half the runs at 128^2 (20261026T1530-c00-marangoni-minority-lineages); how it persists and whether an environment can make it spread are now open questions (Q:marangoni-*). S, I, B, W and D stand as in 20261026T1130-c00-audit-marangoni.

observations.S: rerun/seed61-64/sheet.png at t=0: uniform noise over the whole domain; rods by frame 30
observations.I: rerun/seed61-64/FACTS.md: discrete rods, 13-19 split-born dividing tracks per seed
observations.B: Claim's sd_individuals.py ch2 on rerun seeds 51/52: 100% of 557/591 body-frames have rim/core and rim/out >= 1.5 (rim/core 2.58/2.60, rim/out 11.15/11.06); 12.4 at 1.5x grid. Caveat: the ring is placed by a drift written against phi and counts only through the rod-only source. chis0 removes the rim (rim/core 0.73).
observations.D: rerun/seed61-64/lineage.png: repeated binary fission into lasting daughters; 13-19 dividing tracks per seed
observations.W: w_table.txt: rerun/seed51 and rerun/seed52 cargo in/out 9.27 and 9.00, 100% of body-frames >= 2x, 78/78 and 65/65 daughters >= 2x five frames after birth; controls/res15_seed51 (dx 2/3, T=500): 15-24x
observations.M: rerun/seed62 track 30 swims 4.67 of its own lengths between its birth by fission and its fission into two lasting daughters; also seed 61 #20 (3.23), seed 62 #19 (3.16), seed 63 #11 (4.18), seed 64 #15 (4.45); a minority: 5 of 61 dividing tracks on seeds 61-64 (files in 20261026T1530-c00-marangoni-minority-lineages); mar=0 removes it

seeds_run.result: pass: 1 of 15 dividing tracks swims >= 3 own lengths

controls_run.W: controls/walloff_seed51 (cargo coupled to an unadsorbed surfactant copy, bodies bitwise identical): in/out 0.17; controls/kappa0_seed51: 1.39x (w_table.txt); seed 52 in 20261026T1130-c00-audit-marangoni
controls_run.M: research/alife/collective/contrib/20261026T1130-c00-audit-marangoni/mlength/: dividing tracks past 3 rod lengths 0 and 0 on seeds 51 and 52

verdicts.limitation: M is a minority trait: about 5% of dividing rods on these seeds, absent on seeds 51, 52 and the 1.5x grid, and not inherited (parent-offspring slope of per-cycle distance +0.22 [-0.61, +1.44]). The claim's statement should give the prevalence, not describe swimming-then-dividing as typical. B and W were measured on seeds 51-52 by 20261026T1130-c00-audit-marangoni, not re-measured on 61-64. The ring is placed by a drift written against phi and counts for B through the rod-only source; most cargo is in the bath; D needs the global relaxation feed.
